author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced.

author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project including Pokemon art
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: maitespena
title: Seeking illustrators for character art for book social media promo
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Additional: All characters are adults, some non-human (demons, magical beings). Adult novel with humor, seeking simple colorful style.
